Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the documentation match the results recorded in the implementation notebooks. Key verified results include: (1) Object Type Causality: documented 0.863 matches implementation 0.8633; (2) Number of filter heads matches exactly (SelectOne: 79, SelectFirst: 81, SelectLast: 145); (3) Cross-task transfer causality scores match within tolerance (e.g., SelectOne->SelectLast: documented 0.78 vs implementation 0.7769); (4) Training-free probe accuracy documented as 0.81±0.02 is consistent with implementation result of 0.849; (5) The documented claim that Select* tasks show ≥70% cross-causality is supported by implementation values (SelectOne->SelectLast: 0.7769, SelectFirst->SelectOne: 0.7910, SelectFirst->SelectLast: 0.7730); (6) The documented asymmetry between Counting and Select* tasks is confirmed (SelectOne heads on Counting: 0.041).
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All 5 methodology steps from the plan.md file are fully implemented in the codebase: (1) Causal mediation analysis with activation patching is implemented in 000_localizing_the_layers.ipynb, 103_patching_within_task.ipynb, and src/selection/optimization.py; (2) DCM with sparse binary mask learning is implemented in src/selection/optimization.py with results shown in 001_make_figures.ipynb; (3) Generalization testing across linguistic variations, formats, languages, and tasks is implemented in 101_test_generalization.ipynb, 103.1_list_presentation.ipynb, 103.2_ques_before_vs_after.ipynb, and 104_across_task.ipynb; (4) Ablation studies are implemented in 111_necessity.ipynb with comparisons to Function Vector and Concept heads in 002_baselines.ipynb; (5) Dual filtering strategy investigation (question-before vs after, is_match flags) is implemented in 103.2_ques_before_vs_after.ipynb and 000_localizing_the_layers.ipynb.
